title.rendered: What is the PF_RING ZC distribution format?

content.rendered: PF_RING ZC is made of two components: kernel drivers and user-space library. The kernel driver is released in source format as part of PF_RING, whereas the user-space library is released in binary format and it requires a per-MAC licenses.
